## Checklist

- [ ] Behavior changes and bug fixes have tests (logic extracted to testable functions)
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build` pass (frontend changes)
- [ ] `dotnet test` and `dotnet csharpier check .` pass (backend changes)
- [ ] New endpoints are admin-only unless deliberately public (and `EndpointSecurityTests` updated)
- [ ] EF migration added and reviewed if the model changed
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` or `appsettings.*.json` committed
- [ ] User-facing text is in Spanish
